patches.description: Map output delay through bounded queued source intervals, preserving loop discontinuities and unknown timestamps; includes unit coverage.
Account for pending device audio, freeze paused delay, preserve clock access during decoder restarts, and avoid draining on user pause.
Preserve the AVFoundation queued sample timeline on source underrun; invalidate it only on flush.
Refresh seekable sources before replacing an output that discards queued samples; preserve pending user seeks.
Round both PCM range endpoints to nearest samples, with forward half ties; includes boundary tests.
Local read-only capability for VSF opt-in integration; keep separate from potential upstream patches.
Preserve exact-seek loop eligibility through playback restart, where rounded audio endpoints may already have drained; keep resolved-position checks for approximate seeks.
Schedule EOF wakeups only for consumed pull queues awaiting presentation; preserve push-output completion notifications instead of polling zero delay.
Pass AudioChannelLayout to the matching input-scope AudioUnit property; restore mono CoreAudio initialization and preserve stereo channel identity.
